earnings.title: Alliant Energy Corporation
highlights: Third quarter GAAP earnings per share were $1.52 in 2026, compared to $1.09 in 2025

MADISON, Wis. - October 29, 2026 - Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) today announced U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) consolidated unaudited earnings per share (EPS) of $1.52 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.09 for the third quarter of 2025.
For the first nine months of 2026, Alliant Energy reported EPS of $3.04, a 17% increase from $2.59 for the same period in 2025.
Ongoing EPS for the first nine months of 2026 was $2.99, a 14% increase from $2.62 for the same period in 2025.
Retail electric and gas sales increased EPS by an estimated $0.05 and $0.03 per share in the third quarters of 2026 and 2025, respectively, due to the impacts of temperatures on customer demand.

quotes.text: We delivered another solid quarter of operating performance and our full-year earnings expectation has been narrowed to within the top half of the original 2026 ongoing EPS guidance range.
quotes.by: Lisa Barton, Alliant Energy President and CEO

outlook: Narrowed 2026 ongoing earnings guidance to $3.41 - $3.46 per share, the top half of the original guidance range
Announced 2027 earnings guidance range of $3.63 - $3.73 per share a nd 2027 annual common stock dividend target of $2.25 per share
Increased four-year capital expenditure forecast by 19% to $15.9 billion to meet growing demand
Based on results for the first nine months of 2026, ongoing earnings per share guidance was narrowed to $3.41 - $3.46.
